battle.wolf_win.speaker: Narration
battle.wolf_win.text: The wolf falls. Purple flame scatters into ash.

battle.wolf_win.speaker: Thought
battle.wolf_win.text: So this is the Black Flame. Even beasts…

battle.wolf_lose.speaker: System
battle.wolf_lose.text: You wake by the roadside. Someone laid a cloak over you.

battle.leo_lose.speaker: Leo
battle.leo_lose.text: Go back to gripping grass roots.

battle.leo_lose.speaker: System
battle.leo_lose.text: You wake in the fields outside the walls. Try again whenever.

battle.fog_lose.speaker: System
battle.fog_lose.text: Carried back to the village. Wait for the white flash.

battle.demon_lose.speaker: System
battle.demon_lose.text: You fall on the tower steps. Just climb from the bottom again.

battle.abo_lose.speaker: Abo
battle.abo_lose.text: No way in your fist yet. Again.

battle.abo_lose.speaker: System
battle.abo_lose.text: You were shown out of the Trial Hall. The door isn't shut.

battle.falcon_lose.speaker: Swiftshadow
battle.falcon_lose.text: The wind took you. Wait once more.

battle.falcon_lose.speaker: System
battle.falcon_lose.text: You wake in the treehouse. Next time, wait for its pause.

battle.boar_lose.speaker: Stonefist
battle.boar_lose.text: Not enough strength. Stand firm and come again. The job isn't done.

battle.boar_lose.speaker: System
battle.boar_lose.text: The waves push you back to the docks. Meet the charge.

battle.rift_lose.speaker: System
battle.rift_lose.text: The Black Flame throws you back below the tower. {tip}

battle.world_flee.speaker: System
battle.world_flee.text: You got out alive. Find a save stone first.
